title: Doorprints kind file a person adds, doorprints-kind/1 under the user profile
description: A kind a person adds by importing a file (a gym, a cafe, an office; docs/03 ADR-39): the built-in kind format (`kind.schema.json`, every rule of it applies through `allOf`) with a stricter profile. The id starts `u_`, so it can never be or shadow a built-in id (house, school, the test kind); every label is the person's own words (`textLabel`), shown as written in every language; there are no `words` (the app's neutral words name the kind's entries) and no `was`; the `ai` slots are empty (no AI reads a kind a person adds); the question seed is one of the built-in banks' paths and the question scopes are the one `BOTH`; the limits are smaller. Data only: nothing here is code, a link that is fetched, markup or map configuration (the map keys are refused anywhere, India's boundaries apply to every kind, ADR-22). What a schema cannot say, the readers check too, the same on every stack (`user-kind-vectors.json`): the file is at most 64 KiB, a key is not repeated in one object, nesting is at most 8 deep, at most 4,000 values, no key `__proto__`, `constructor` or `prototype`, ids are unique, the `search`, Compare and filter ids name the kind's own fields, at most 300 options in all, and no lone surrogate in a text.

text.description: Only the person's own words: a key label (`web`, `android`) is refused in a kind a person adds.
